Author: Trans1st0r
Description:
你好，谢谢您的点击，也许也谢谢您的下载。我是中国星露谷爱好者，b站和p站都叫风吟梧桦！

视频教程：[u][color=#1e84cc][size=2]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Lm411z7iU/?vd_source=11eb192e42629b8b146666b208368dca[/size][/color][/u] 真的不可能在不会用啦！！

[color=#ff0000]本mod适用版本 [size=4][b]SDV 1.6 [/b]及更高[/size]，请下载 Portraiture 时使用支持 [b]SDV 1.6 [/b]的版本！！！！！[/color]

该mod分为两个部分：
[list=1]
[*][color=#00ffff]高清肖像[/color]。该mod前置为Portraiture，请在安装了Portraiture以后将下载得到的压缩包直接解压到Stardew Valley/Mods文件夹中，会自动在Stardew Valley /Mods/Portraiture/Portraits创建中KivoValley文件夹。进入存档后，与任意村民对话，按“M”键选中"KivoValley"包。

[*][color=#00ffff]人物sprites[/color]。该mod前置为ContentPatcher，安装方法同一般模组，解压到Stardew Valley/Mods文件夹下，可以被Stardrop Mod Manager识别，安装成功后启动时标题栏识别的mod会+1。
[/list]
[color=#00ff00]并不包含季节性变化，这可以实现，但是目前并没有计划！[/color]

该Mod将作为一个系列逐渐出现，敬请期待！
所有肖像资源归作者所有，请勿转载！

***** XD *****

English Translation: (with assistance of GPT, I'm sorry if you have problem understanding orz)

[color=#ff0000]This mod is applicable to [size=4][b]SDV 1.6[/b] and above[/size]. Please use a version that supports [b]SDV 1.6[/b] when downloading Portrait[/color]

This mod is divided into two parts:
[list=1]
[*][color=#00ffff]HD Portraits[/color]. This mod requires Portraiture as a prerequisite. After installing Portraiture, unzip the downloaded package directly into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder. It will automatically create a KivoValley folder in Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits. After entering a save file, talk to any villager and press the "M" key to select the "KivoValley" pack. [color=#ff7700](If you renamed the Portraiture mod folder please copy the KivoValley folder to "NewName/Portraits/KivoValley")[/color]
[*][color=#00ffff]Character sprites[/color]. This mod requires ContentPatcher as a prerequisite, and the installation method is the same as for general mods. Unzip it into the Stardew Valley/Mods folder so that it can be recognized by Stardrop Mod Manager. After installation, the number of mods recognized in the title bar at startup will increase by one.
[/list]
[color=#00ff00]Seasonal sprites are not in my plan.[/color][color=#00ff00]
[/color]
This Mod will gradually appear as a series, so stay tuned! All portrait resources are owned by the author. Please do not repost!
